summary: The filing is a Form 6-K report by DoubleDown Interactive disclosing a $10,000 charitable donation to the American Cancer Society for National Cancer Survivors Month. It includes a press release describing a play-to-enter giveaway. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, restructuring, or other special situation is present. The filing is a routine corporate announcement with no deal terms or structural changes.
